title: Building Fast React Sites with Vite
excerpt: How Vite speeds up development and improves production builds.
content:
Vite provides a fast development server and lightning-fast HMR.

In this post we explore how to set up Vite with React and Tailwind, and some tips to optimize build size and loading performance.

title: Designing Accessible Components
excerpt: Small accessibility improvements that make a big difference.
content:
Accessibility is not optional.

We cover semantic HTML, ARIA basics, keyboard navigation, and focus management to make components usable for everyone.

title: Simple SEO Tips for Portfolio Sites
excerpt: On-page SEO tactics that help your portfolio get found.
content:
A few on-page SEO practices: good titles, meta descriptions, structured data, and fast page speed.

This post walks through practical steps you can apply today.
